title: SPO - Smart Farmer Procurement
description: An agritech digital procurement platform connecting farmers directly to institutional buyers with transparent price discovery and real-time mandi rate indexing.
problemSolved: Traditional agricultural procurement suffers from opaque mandi pricing and heavy intermediary commissions. SPO establishes transparent market rate indices, direct-to-buyer bidding, and verified digital lot scheduling.
keyFeatures: Live Mandi price indexing vs SPO direct pricing comparison engine.
Interactive crop lot negotiation & dynamic contract generation.
Multi-lingual farmer-friendly procurement workflow.
Production-ready deployment hosted at spo-snowy.vercel.app.

title: VoltPath AI
description: An AI-powered electrical vehicle (EV) charging station locator and slot reservation platform built for next-generation green mobile transit systems.
problemSolved: EV drivers suffer from dynamic queue uncertainty and lack of charger coordination. VoltPath AI solves this with real-time station reservation, predicting slot availability, and offering automated routing.
keyFeatures: Interactive map overlays highlighting real-time station nodes.
Predictive slot booking reservation logic using Firebase live syncing.
Secure user profile dashboards for scheduling and checkout.
Algorithmic route finder recommending optimal charging checkpoints.

title: Secure-Fill
description: A production-ready cryptographically secured dynamic form filler and robust transactional record dispatcher built to prevent critical client-side leakage.
problemSolved: Traditional web forms transmit plain input fields across unprotected channels. Secure-Fill ensures all user queries are safely isolated, analyzed, and dispatched via AES-level client-protecting sandboxes.
keyFeatures: Dynamic data field sandboxing isolating malicious input scripts.
Secure encrypted direct dispatch pipelines into database buffers.
Beautiful high-contrast responsive interface designed for quick data tasks.
Live client-side input validation and leak verification logs.

title: Grave-Ambition-Vault
description: A spooky-themed digital vault engineered for storing, securing, and beautifully showcasing vital achievements, milestones, and high-impact completed projects.
problemSolved: Traditional student portfolios fail to engage visitors or tell an exciting story. This project transforms passive resume viewing into an immersive milestone expedition, allowing viewers to unearth unlocked trophies.
keyFeatures: Thematic Spooky Visual State with responsive vault door lock models.
Milestone-based progress tracker unlocking badges progressively.
Base44 dynamic encryption framework for key achievements.
Staggered, physics-rich particle canvas backdrops.

title: DSPACE
description: An intelligent, highly interactive data simulation and communication suite that enables standard users to query, analyze, and render dynamic visual content effortlessly using smart models.
problemSolved: Raw static datasets are sterile and difficult for non-technical users to query. DSPACE integrates responsive chat inputs and robust render engines to dynamically parse data streams into human-guided diagrams.
keyFeatures: Natural language analytical compiler turning queries to visuals.
Responsive component layers adapting charts in real-time.
Configurable data matrix simulation engine.
Elegant glassmorphic chat interfaces integrated with secure proxies.
